description: This file contains Swagger API resource definitions for holiday-related endpoints in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for holiday data.

classes.name: HolidaysApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining request and response schemas for holiday API endpoints.

classes.name: GetHolidaysResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving holiday details, including id, name, date range, office id, and status.

classes.name: PostHolidaysRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new holiday, including name, description, date format, locale, date range, and associated offices.

classes.name: PostHolidaysRequestOffices
classes.description: Schema for specifying office IDs in holiday creation requests.

classes.name: PostHolidaysResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a holiday, returning resource ID.

classes.name: PostHolidaysHolidayIdRequest
classes.description: Empty request schema for holiday ID operations.

classes.name: PostHolidaysHolidayIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for holiday ID operations, returning resource ID.

classes.name: PutHolidaysHolidayIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating holiday details such as name and description.

classes.name: PutHolidaysHolidayIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for updating a holiday, including resource ID and changes.

classes.name: PutHolidaysHolidayIdResponse.PutHolidaysHolidayIdResponseChanges
classes.description: Schema for specifying changes in holiday update responses.

classes.name: DeleteHolidaysHolidayIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a holiday, returning resource ID.
